summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on a CI release-gate workflow, and separately provide a corrected build command for the web app after a monorepo package split.
summary.outcome: Two CodeRabbit review threads about stale-pass holes in E2E polling logic were fixed and resolved; polling timeouts were also aligned from 20 min to 45 min to match the Desktop E2E job duration. The corrected pnpm build command with full dependency chain was provided.

repo: The cipherbox repo is a pnpm monorepo split into packages: api-client, crypto, core, sdk-core, sdk, web — each must be built in dependency order.
Dependency chain: api-client + crypto (leaf) → core → sdk-core → sdk → web.
The release-gate workflow polls ci-e2e.yml for both Web E2E and Desktop E2E results; Desktop E2E can take up to 45 minutes.
E2E polling windows were set to 20 minutes (MAX_ATTEMPTS=40) which was insufficient for the 45-minute Desktop E2E timeout.

code.finding: MAX_ATTEMPTS was 40 (20 min at 30s intervals) for both Web and Desktop E2E polling steps; raised to 90 (45 min) to match Desktop E2E job duration.

workflow: CodeRabbit flags stale-pass bugs where fallback logic scans past failures and can incorrectly pass — fix is to treat the first matching result as authoritative.
Process substitution is needed in bash to propagate exit codes correctly when piping in polling scripts.
When replying to PR review comments via gh CLI, use --field (not -f) for integer parameters like in_reply_to.
Resolving review threads requires GraphQL mutation resolveReviewThread, while posting replies uses the REST API.

friction: The web app build was broken after the monorepo split because the build command was not updated to include all internal @cipherbox packages.
The 20-minute polling timeout was silently insufficient for Desktop E2E — no explicit failure surfaced until code review flagged the stale-pass hole.
Two separate polling steps in the same workflow share the same underlying ci-e2e.yml run, creating an implicit coupling that wasn't obvious from the step definitions.
open_items: The corrected pnpm build command should be propagated to CI configuration and documentation so it doesn't drift again.
Consider whether the two E2E polling steps (Web and Desktop) should be unified or share timeout configuration to avoid future mismatches.
Verify no other workflows still use the old build command without the full package dependency chain.
